summary: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds image understanding to text-only model flows by using a configurable vision model to convert chat images and Feishu/Lark document images into text descriptions.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin’s primary purpose is to add image understanding to DeepSeek Harness conversations by describing images as text for text-only models, including pasted chat images and Feishu/Lark document images, which is a user-facing image-capability enhancement rather than code editing or generic plugin tooling. It is conservatively categorized as a media tools plugin with tags reflecting image handling, chat integration, external model API usage, and document image flow.
